name: Viking 2
best_known_for: Second Viking: an orbiter and a lander that worked in Utopia Planitia until 1980
credit: The second Viking spacecraft, an orbiter carrying a lander. Launched 1975-09-09 on a Titan IIIE-Centaur; orbit insertion 1976-08-07; lander touchdown 1976-09-03 in Utopia Planitia. Orbiter ended 1978-07-24 per the NASA mission page (NSSDCA gives 25 July), lander 1980-04-12 (science.nasa.gov/mission/viking-2/, NSSDCA 1975-083A). Manufacturers from Wikipedia.
